title: Finish a task, leave a footprint
caption:
Finish a task, leave a footprint 👣

Footprints add up as you get things done, walk, or write a line in your diary. Spend them on tiny furniture for the room your charms live in.

Daily Charm is free to start on the App Store (iPhone). Search “Daily Charm”.

#todolist #habittracker #cozyapps #productivity #dailycharm

veo.prompt: Stop-motion style scene of a tiny cozy room with a green sofa, a potted plant, a floor lamp, a rug, a window and glass footprints on the floor. Very subtle motion: the plant's leaves sway slightly, clouds drift slowly in the window, the glass footprints catch small glints of light. Nothing new appears: no characters, no animals, no people, no objects are added, and nothing moves from its place. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, soft warm even light, calm and cozy.

end.line: Free to start on the App Store
